instant-p2p.safety_warning.heading: §lWarning!
instant-p2p.safety_warning.message:
This mod only helps you connect to a LAN server.
Problems between users are not our responsibility.
P2P can expose your IP - turn on 'Force Relay' to prevent that.
Beware of unknown servers asking for personal info, links or downloads!
instant-p2p.streamer_protection.heading: §lNotice!
instant-p2p.streamer_protection.message:
Streamer protection is now on.
A linked streamer who is live can kick or temp-ban users.
instant-p2p.join_broadcast_warning.messa:
This room disallows broadcasting. Join anyway?
If you are live, switch the broadcast filter to 'Broadcast-allowed only'.
instant-p2p.join_capacity_warning.messag:
This room is full.
Joining anyway with your developer/supporter privilege.
